    ‘CORPORATION, n. An ingenious device for obtaining individual profit without individual responsibility.’ - Ambrose Bierce

    ‘CORPORATION, n. An ingenious device for obtaining individual profit without individual responsibility.’ - Ambrose Bierce

    This is one of a series of articles that I hope to compile into a book – working title, The Commoners’ Manifesto: Neither Capitalism nor Communism. Here’s an introduction to the series. Comments welcome, including disagreement and debate.

    In the first 3 articles I argued that anti-capitalists should reject state communism as a route to a post-capitalist world. I then looked at how states have been captured by corporations. In the next 5 articles I’ll look at what captured states do in return for corporations.
